title.narrative: Access to adequate housing and integral risk management in indigenous communities in Mexico
Zugang zu angemessenem Wohnraum und integrales Risikomanagement in indigenen Gemeinden in Mexiko

description.narrative: The project region was recently hit hard by natural disasters (earthquakes, tropical storms, hurricanes).
